info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description: Task management REST API with JWT authentication, per-user task ownership, filtering, pagination, soft deletion, comments, and a database-aware health check.

get.description: Returns API liveness together with a lightweight `SELECT 1` database readiness check. This endpoint is unauthenticated and never returns connection strings, credentials, or exception details.

200.description: The API and database are reachable.

503.description: The API is running but the database is unreachable.

post.description: Creates an account with a unique email and an Argon2id password hash. Emails are normalized to lowercase. The response never includes the password or password hash.

201.description: The newly created public user record.

422.description: Request body, query, or path validation failed.

fields.message: String should have at least 1 character

500.description: A database operation failed; details are logged server-side.

post.summary: Log in and obtain an access token
post.description: Authenticates an email/password pair using the OAuth2 password form. `username` carries the registered email address. Unknown emails and wrong passwords return the same generic 401 to prevent account enumeration. The endpoint is limited to five requests per minute per client IP.

200.description: A Bearer access token for the authenticated user.

401.description: The email or password is incorrect.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication scheme for the failed request.

422.description: Request body, query, or path validation failed.

fields.message: String should have at least 1 character

429.description: The per-IP login rate limit was exceeded.

get.description: Returns the safe public profile associated with the Bearer token. No password material is exposed.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or user-less Bearer token.

get.summary: List, filter, search, sort, and paginate owned tasks
get.description: Returns only tasks owned by the authenticated user, excluding soft-deleted tasks. Filters, case-insensitive title search, sorting, counting, and pagination all run in the database. Pagination metadata is returned in `X-Total-Count`, `X-Limit`, and `X-Offset` headers.

post.description: Creates a comment on an active task owned by the authenticated user. The author always comes from the JWT; task access checks reject missing or deleted tasks with 404 and other users' tasks with 403.
